# Frontier LLM Report

**Immutable instructions: do not edit this file.**

Write `report.md` about the frontier LLM evidence available as of the frozen
22 July 2026 snapshot. SearXNG is available at `SEARXNG_URL` and
`SEARXNG_BASE_URL`; do not use evidence published after the snapshot date.
If web search is useful, use your harness's web-search tool, run
`sh .agent_scripts/search.sh "query"`, or query the SearXNG API directly with curl.

## Required Markdown format

Use exactly this document title and these H2 chapters, each once and in order:

```markdown
# Frontier LLM Report
## Snapshot Scope
## Models
## Evidence
## Benchmark Interpretation
## Conclusion
```

Under **Models**, include a Markdown table whose header is exactly
`| Model | Provider | Evidence |`. Compare at least three named model families,
cite at least three distinct source URLs, and cover capability, cost, latency,
context length, safety, and evaluation limits. Explain how benchmarks depend on
task, prompting, tools, reproducibility, and possible contamination. Cite
sources rather than claiming an unverifiable single "best" model. State
22 July 2026 as the as-of date and explain why your sources support that date.
You may add useful H2 chapters after the required chapters, but every heading
must be unique.
